schema: cairn/lesson/v0.1
id: java-appium-override-server-url-missing-ssrf-check
title: overrideServerUrl switches HTTP client to server-supplied URL without host safety validation
summary: The Appium command executor's overrideServerUrl builds a new HTTP client from a URL (taken from
  the direct-connect values in a remote server's session response) without checking where the host resolves.
  A malicious or compromised server can redirect subsequent client traffic to loopback, link-local/metadata,
  unspecified, or multicast addresses, enabling SSRF. The fix validates the target through DirectConnectUrlSafety.requireSafeOverrideTarget
  before creating the client.
cwe:
- CWE-918
severity: medium
confidence: medium
languages:
- java
source:
  kind: fix-commit
  ref: 2b9cd442b9dbf56ccc6f1e83aeeb411c0ec230c9
  vulnerable_ref: 2b9cd442b9dbf56ccc6f1e83aeeb411c0ec230c9^
  patched_ref: 2b9cd442b9dbf56ccc6f1e83aeeb411c0ec230c9
  repository: https://github.com/appium/java-client
rule:
  message: 'This method creates a new HTTP client for a caller-supplied URL without first validating the
    target host

    (loopback, link-local, unspecified, multicast). A remote server controlling this URL can cause SSRF.

    Call DirectConnectUrlSafety.requireSafeOverrideTarget($URL) before creating the client.

    '
  patterns:
  - pattern: "$RET overrideServerUrl(URL $URL) {\n  ...\n  $F.createClient(<... $URL ...>);\n  ...\n}\n"
  - pattern-not: "$RET overrideServerUrl(URL $URL) {\n  ...\n  DirectConnectUrlSafety.requireSafeOverrideTarget($URL);\n\
      \  ...\n}\n"
fix:
  guidance: Before building a new HTTP client for a URL that came from the server (such as the direct-connect
    URL), call DirectConnectUrlSafety.requireSafeOverrideTarget on it. It resolves the host and refuses
    loopback, link-local, unspecified and multicast addresses. Only create the client and replace the
    executor's client after that check passes.
  example: "protected void overrideServerUrl(URL serverUrl) {\n    DirectConnectUrlSafety.requireSafeOverrideTarget(serverUrl);\n\
    \    HttpClient newClient = getHttpClientFactory().createClient(appiumClientConfig.baseUrl(serverUrl));\n\
    \    setPrivateFieldValue(HttpCommandExecutor.class, \"client\", newClient);\n}\n"
